paite: TOUPA aw, nangmah ah ka ginna ka koih zel hi; chik mah chiang in zahlak in hon omsak ke'n.
heading: Putek Thumna Leh Phatna
english: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

paite: Na diktatna vang in hon humbit in, hon honkhia in; kei lam ah na bil hon doh inla, hon hondam in.
english: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

paite: Kei a ding in omna suangpi, ka hoh theihgigena hong hi in, nang hon hondam ding in thu na pia a; ka suangpi leh ka kulhpi na hi ngal a.
english: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

paite: Ka Pathian aw, migilou-salou khut a kipan hon honkhia in, midiktat lou leh nunsia khut a kipan.
english: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

paite: TOUPA Pathian aw, nang ka lamet na hi; ka naupan chik a kipan ka hon muan na hi.
english: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh, my confidence from my youth.

paite: Ka nu gil a kipan in nangmah na hon len zel a, ka nu sung a kipan hon lakhepa na hi; ahi nangmah ka hon phat gige ding.
english: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.

paite: Mi tampi theih in thillamdang ka hi a; himahleh ka kihumbitna kiptak na hi.
english: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

paite: Ka kam nang phatna in adim ding a, nitum in nang pahtawina in adim ding hi.
english: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.

paite: Ka tek chiang in hon nial ke'nla, ka bah chiang in hon paisan ke'n.
english: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

paite: Ka melmate'n ka tungthu agen ua; ka hinna tangte leng akikum uhi.
english: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

paite: Pathian in apaisanta, delh unla, man un; humbitpa ding himhim a-om ngal kei a, chi in.
english: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

paite: Pathian aw, hon gamlat mahmah ke'n; ka Pathian aw, hon panpih ding in kin in.
english: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

paite: Ka hinna tung a melmate zahlak leh mangthang in om uhenla; ka siatna zongte gensiatna leh zumna a khuh in om uhen.
english: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

paite: Himahleh ke'n zaw ka lamen gige ding a, ka hon phat semsem ding hi.
english: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

paite: Ka kam in na diktatna thu agen ding a, nitum in na hotdamna thu agen ding a; atamdan ka thei ngal kei a.
english: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN thilhih thupiakte toh ka hong pai ding a, adiktatna, nangmah diktatna thu kia ka gen ding hi.
english: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

paite: Pathian aw, ka naupan chik a kipan nang na hon hilh a; tutan in na thillamdang hihte ka theisak gige hi.
english: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

paite: Ahi, Pathian aw, ka tek a ka sam akan hun in hon paisan mahmah ke'n; na hatna hiai khangte kiang leh, na thilhihtheihna khang hong om lai dingte kiang a ka theihsak mateng.
english: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

paite: Pathian aw, na diktatna leng asang mahmah ahi; Pathian aw, nang thil thupitakte hihpa, nangmah bang kua a-om a?
english: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?

paite: Nang, buaina tampi leh thupitak hon musakpa'n na hon hingsak nawn dia, lei thukpi a kipan na hon pikhe nawn ding hi.
english: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

paite: Nang ka thupina hon hihpungsak inla, hong kihei nawn inla, hon khamuan in.
english: Increase my honor and comfort me again.

paite: Pekging in ka hon phat ding a, ka Pathian aw, na thutak ka phat ding hi, Nang Israelte Mi Siangthou aw, kaihging toh nang phat in la ka sa ding.
english: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

paite: Nangmah phat a la ka sak chiang in ka muk anuam mahmah ding a; na tatsa ka hinna mah leng nuam asa mahmah ding hi.
english: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

paite: Ka lei in leng nitum in na diktatna thu agen ding; ka siatna ding zongte azahlak un azumta uhi.
english: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
